facts.text: An articulated dumper or loader cannot be represented as a straight point mass for every maneuver.
facts.quote: An articulated dumper or loader cannot be reduced to a straight point mass for every maneuver.

facts.text: A straight point-mass model may adequately predict stopping distance for an articulated dumper or loader in a straight, low-severity stop.
facts.quote: In a straight, low-severity stop that model may predict stopping distance adequately

facts.text: During braking while steering, on a cross-slope, or at a large articulation angle, yaw, roll, load transfer and articulation dynamics can limit the usable deceleration of an articulated dumper or loader.
facts.quote: while braking during steering, on a cross-slope, or at a large articulation angle, yaw, roll, load transfer and articulation dynamics can limit the usable deceleration.

facts.text: The off-road evidence on articulated-machine braking dynamics is academic and mostly scaled.
facts.quote: The off-road evidence is academic and mostly scaled.

facts.text: Multibody models of articulated wheel loaders use 7 and 8 degrees of freedom, Fiala tire models and active braking, and treat roll instability as the critical mode. The cited studies are two Li et al. papers in Mathematical Problems in Engineering from 2016 and a related lateral-stability paper from 2013.
facts.quote: Multibody models of articulated wheel loaders with 7 and 8 degrees of freedom, Fiala tire models and active braking treat roll instability as the critical mode;

facts.text: The articulated-wheel-loader multibody models reported by Li et al. were validated against a scaled wheel loader and then applied to a ZL50 machine.
facts.quote: they were validated against a scaled wheel loader and then applied to a ZL50 machine

facts.text: An 8-degree-of-freedom simulation reproduced jackknifing of road tractor-semitrailers during braking on a downgrade, as reported in JSAE Review in 2003. This is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: For road tractor-semitrailers, jackknifing during braking on a downgrade was reproduced in an 8-degree-of-freedom simulation (JSAE Review, 2003)

facts.text: A vendor's 22-degree-of-freedom articulated road-vehicle simulation example addresses jackknife, oscillation and rollover. This is on-road evidence.
facts.quote: a vendor's 22-degree-of-freedom articulated road-vehicle example addresses jackknife, oscillation and rollover.

facts.text: The cited independent road tractor-semitrailer simulation and vendor articulated road-vehicle example show that jackknife, oscillation and rollover states are dynamically important, but both provide only on-road evidence.
facts.quote: Both show that these states are dynamically important, but both are on-road.

facts.text: Published data on jackknife or roll events during automatic braking of articulated off-road machines were not found.
facts.quote: Published data on jackknife or roll events during automatic braking of articulated off-road machines: not found.

facts.text: Draft ISO/PRF 21815-5 explicitly treats articulation movement, distinguishing articulation of a stationary machine from ordinary steering during travel.
facts.quote: ISO/PRF 21815-5 treats articulation movement explicitly, distinguishing articulation of a stationary machine from ordinary steering during travel

facts.text: Draft ISO/PRF 21815-5 also covers four-wheel steer and towed-trailer reverse motion.
facts.quote: and also covers four-wheel steer and towed-trailer reverse motion.
